content.user_title: Design Data Science Experiments and Models
content.value_statement: Data science projects often fail when experiments, features, and models lack clear statistical structure. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code guided workflows for experimentation, feature engineering, and model review.
actual_capabilities: Explains experiment design, feature engineering, and statistical methods through reference guides.
Provides scaffold Python command-line tools for experiment planning, feature processing, and model evaluation.
Covers production ML topics such as monitoring, deployment, reliability, and privacy controls.
Lists practical workflows for A/B testing, statistical review, and stakeholder communication.
Helps structure data science decisions around scale, cost, compliance, and measurable outcomes.
limitations: The included scripts are scaffolds and do not perform real modeling or feature generation.
It does not include datasets, trained models, notebooks, or production configuration files.
Deployment commands are examples and need user review before execution.
Statistical recommendations require project context, data quality checks, and domain validation.

use_cases.title: Plan an A/B Test
use_cases.description: Define metrics, sample size, guardrails, and analysis steps before a product experiment starts.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Strategy
use_cases.description: Organize candidate features, leakage checks, monitoring needs, and validation criteria for a model project.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Analysis
use_cases.description: Turn statistical results into clear trade-offs, risks, and recommended business actions.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Experiment Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a simple test design for a product change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an A/B test plan for this product change: [describe change]. Include hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, sample needs, and decision rules.

prompt_templates.title: Feature Review Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: You have candidate model features and need a structured review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these candidate features for a predictive model: [feature list]. Identify leakage risks, transformations, monitoring checks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Model Evaluation Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: You need to compare model performance for stakeholders.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these model results: [metrics and context]. Explain performance, uncertainty, fairness concerns, production risks, and a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Causal Analysis
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a rigorous causal approach for a business question.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a causal analysis for this question: [business question]. Include identification assumptions, data requirements, threats to validity, sensitivity checks, and communication plan.

output_examples.input: Request: Design an A/B test for a new onboarding flow.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a test plan with hypothesis, primary activation metric, guardrail metrics, sample size inputs, launch criteria, and interpretation guidance.

output_examples.input: Request: Review features for a churn prediction model.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a feature review with leakage warnings, transformation ideas, missing data checks, drift monitoring, and validation recommendations.

output_examples.input: Request: Explain model evaluation results to executives.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes accuracy trade-offs, confidence limits, operational risks, and a plain-language recommendation for the business decision.

best_practices: Provide business context, metric definitions, and known data quality issues before asking for analysis.
Ask for assumptions, validation checks, and failure modes with every experiment or model recommendation.
Review any suggested command or deployment step before running it in a real environment.
anti_patterns: Do not treat scaffold scripts as complete production pipelines.
Do not use statistical guidance without checking data quality and domain assumptions.
Do not run deployment examples without explicit approval and environment review.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure experiment design, feature engineering, model evaluation, and senior data science communication.

faq.question: Does it train models automatically?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are scaffolds, so users must add real modeling logic and data handling.

faq.question: Can it support A/B testing work?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan hypotheses, metrics, guardrails, sample needs, and decision criteria.

faq.question: Is this useful for production ML systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers monitoring, reliability, deployment concerns, privacy, and stakeholder review.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: It is intended for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What should users verify before acting?
faq.answer: Users should verify data quality, assumptions, statistical validity, and any command that changes infrastructure.
